title: metadata save: an object_extension whose record-mode amount names a one-segment currencyField that the served object does not declare is saved 200, then every write of that amount is refused naming a field that does not exist
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzj9DrVWXkq7joYHGB

Observed at objectstack-ai/objectstack b914e7247f69 (v18.5.0), reproduced on two fresh boots, on a stock showcase dev boot (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --no-compile`, file SQLite DB), signed in as the seeded admin.

Reproduction (method · path · body):
1. POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization (no body) → 201 or 200 (the pair com.example.showcase.custom).
2. PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/showcase_invoice?package=com.example.showcase.custom
   body {"extend":"showcase_invoice","fields":{"fee__c":{"type":"currency","label":"Fee","currencyConfig":{"currencyMode":"record","currencyField":"zz_missing__c"}}}}
   → 200 "Saved object_extension 'showcase_invoice' (… package=com.example.showcase.custom, state=active)". The served showcase_invoice now carries fee__c following `zz_missing__c`. Neither the base object nor any extension declares that field.
3. PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_invoice/<any id> {"fee__c":5}
   → 400 "Update on 'showcase_invoice' … was REFUSED: 'fee__c' holds an amount in the record's own currency (currencyMode: 'record'), and its currency code field 'zz_missing__c' is blank. The row was not written. Write the record's ISO 4217 code (for example 'USD') into 'zz_missing__c' in the same write…". The prescribed remedy names a field that does not exist, so no write of fee__c can ever succeed.
4. Cleanup: DELETE the same object_extension address → 200.

Expected: the save in step 2 is refused 422 INVALID_METADATA, naming the missing field and the served object's code-field candidates (here 'currency_code'), as the object-body twin is refused. A PUT of an object body whose amount names an undeclared currencyField (re-measured: new env object qa_fx_zz, amount currencyField 'zz_missing') answers 422 INVALID_METADATA "failed spec validation … `amount.currencyConfig.currencyField` names `zz_missing`, but object `qa_fx_zz` declares no other field…", and since #33621 an extension's two-segment follow pointer is judged against its object as served: `invoice.zz_missing` on a showcase_invoice_line extension → 422 "…'showcase_invoice' declares no field 'zz_missing'… candidates: 'currency_code'", and `invoice.invoice_date` → 422.
Actual: the one-segment pointer of an extension is not judged at any save layer. It is saved and served, and the failure first appears at the first data write, with a prescription that cannot be followed.

Mechanism: packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts `refuseDishonestRecordCurrencyField` (doc at ~line 2027: "Not judged on `ObjectExtensionSchema`: an extension's fields merge into an object it does not hold, so its pointer may name a field only the owner declares"). That is right at schema level. But the served-object judge that #33621 added for extensions (packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts object_extension branch → registry.objectRegistrationRefusal → packages/objectql/src/record-currency-aggregate-door.ts `recordCurrencyFollowRefusal`) covers only the two-segment follow pair (a) and the summary pair (c). The one-segment pointer, judged against the object as served, has no asker. The related open issue #33628 covers the follow door on disable/enable/uninstall. It does not cover this case.

Duplicate search (read-only, open issues): "object_extension currencyField", "extension currencyField record", "extension record-mode amount currency field", "ObjectExtensionSchema currencyField", "currencyField extension not judged" (any state: "extension currency code field blank"). Nearest: #33628 (different paths), #33713 (dynamic roll-up admission, different rule).
Regression vs 18.4.0: not a regression of a shipped refusal. The schema carve-out predates 181ad7d4, and the served judge for extensions is new in this range (#33621) and stops at the two-segment form.

QA-source: #33910 · studio-authoring.currency-field-repointed-refusal · observed beside the clauses
